title: Last Train - Part 1 (demo)
idea: A second-person survival story that teaches one real rule per beat
device: the countdown to the blast is the spine; every rule lands on its word

beats.title: Last train
beats.what: dozing hero, city lights stream past, train sways

beats.title: Phones light up
beats.what: every phone glows, hero jolts awake, ?!
beats.sound: three pings, a thump on the startle

beats.title: The alert
beats.what: red phone close-up, three lines typed on the words

beats.title: Normalcy bias
beats.what: everyone frozen, caption card, 'it's fine' bubble
beats.sound: stamp on the term, pop on the bubble

beats.title: Break the spell
beats.what: hero shakes it off, doors slide, he runs

beats.title: Down is good
beats.what: camera pulls out from the stairs to earth/rock/concrete layers

beats.title: The flash
beats.what: tunnel goes white behind him, long shadow, DON'T LOOK BACK
beats.sound: riser then boom on the white

beats.title: Light first
beats.what: diagram: light instant, wave travels 1 km per 3 s
beats.sound: glock, a long whoosh, ticks per km

beats.title: Count and dive
beats.what: 9, 8 slam; he dives behind a pillar and covers his head
beats.sound: two thunks, whoosh + impact on the landing

beats.title: The shake
beats.what: station shakes, dust, cracks, lights die then red

beats.title: Alive
beats.what: he rises in red light, grim; end card LAST TRAIN Part 1
